description: Get per-insider position aggregates for a given ticker — which insiders hold positions in the stock and their aggregate cost/value. Derived from Form 4 filings. NOT LIFETIME: every figure covers only the Form 4 history Signal8 holds, which starts at the response's `coverageStart` date (also repeated on each row) — say "since <coverageStart>", never "lifetime" or "all-time". Each row carries `costBasisStatus`: `complete` (every share the history knows was bought inside coverage), `partial` (the holding predates coverage, so `weightedAvgCost` averages only in-coverage priced buys and is NOT the cost of the position), or `unknown` (the first in-coverage event was a sale, or there was no priced buy — `weightedAvgCost`/`costBasisTotal` are null, which means NOT MEASURED, never zero cost).
name: get_insider_positions_by_ticker
title: Get Insider Positions by Ticker
